roles/apigee.admin.title: Apigee Organization Admin

roles/apigee.analyticsAgent.title: Apigee Analytics Agent
roles/apigee.analyticsAgent.desc: Curated set of permissions for Apigee Universal Data Collection Agent to manage analytics for an Apigee Organization

roles/apigee.analyticsEditor.title: Apigee Analytics Editor
roles/apigee.analyticsEditor.desc: Analytics editor for an Apigee Organization

roles/apigee.analyticsViewer.title: Apigee Analytics Viewer
roles/apigee.analyticsViewer.desc: Analytics viewer for an Apigee Organization

roles/apigee.apiAdminV2.title: Apigee API Admin
roles/apigee.apiAdminV2.desc: Full read/write access to all apigee API resources

roles/apigee.apimServiceExtensionService.title: Apigee APIM Service Extension Service Agent
roles/apigee.apimServiceExtensionService.desc: Service agent that grants access to the resources for managing the lifecyle for Apigee APIM Service Extensions.

roles/apigee.coreServiceAgent.title: Apigee Core Service Agent
roles/apigee.coreServiceAgent.desc: Service agent that grants access to Apigee resources - API Products, Developers, Developer Apps, App Keys, and Apigee Environments (without granting impersonation permissions).

roles/apigee.deploymentInvoker.title: Apigee Deployment Invoker
roles/apigee.deploymentInvoker.desc: Invoker of deployments in the apigee runtime

roles/apigee.environmentAdmin.title: Apigee Environment Admin
roles/apigee.environmentAdmin.desc: Full read/write access to apigee environment resources, including deployments.

roles/apigee.portalAdmin.title: Apigee Portal Admin
roles/apigee.portalAdmin.desc: Portal admin for an Apigee Organization

roles/apigee.runtimeAgent.title: Apigee Runtime Agent
roles/apigee.runtimeAgent.desc: Curated set of permissions for a runtime agent to access Apigee Organization resources

roles/apigee.securityAdmin.title: Apigee Security Admin
roles/apigee.securityAdmin.desc: Security admin for an Apigee Organization

roles/apigee.securityViewer.title: Apigee Security Viewer
roles/apigee.securityViewer.desc: Security viewer for an Apigee Organization

roles/apigee.serviceAgent.title: Apigee Service Agent
roles/apigee.serviceAgent.desc: Service agent that grants access to Apigee resources - API Products, Developers, Developer Apps, and App Keys.

roles/apigee.spaceConsoleUser.title: Apigee Space Console User
roles/apigee.spaceConsoleUser.desc: Provides users granted permissions on an Apigee space the minimum read permissions required to manage resources in that space in the UI.

roles/apigee.spaceContentEditor.title: Apigee Space Content Editor
roles/apigee.spaceContentEditor.desc: Provides full access to resources that can be associated with a space. This role is intended to be granted at the space level.

roles/apigee.spaceContentViewer.title: Apigee Space Content Viewer
roles/apigee.spaceContentViewer.desc: Provides read access to resources that can be associated with a space. This role is intended to be granted at the space level.

roles/apigee.synchronizerManager.title: Apigee Synchronizer Manager
roles/apigee.synchronizerManager.desc: Curated set of permissions for a Synchronizer to manage environments in an Apigee Organization
